blocks.text: CEBU CITY — A team from at least three police stations stopped an inter-island robbery ring early Tuesday morning, October 27, ending a week-long manhunt for two men from Luzon who allegedly targeted local Small-Town Lottery (STL) booths. Martiniano Casupanan, 52, and Philip Baul Vital, 39, were cornered in Sitio Blackcats, Barangay Duljo Fatima, around 1:30 a.m. Both were originally from Floridablanca, Pampanga, but until recently lived on Macopa Street, Barangay Basak San Nicolas. The breakthrough came hours after the suspects allegedly struck an STL booth in Barangay Quiot around 11:00 p.m. on Monday, October 26. Threatening workers with a firearm, […]...
